newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly higher, except naphtha.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly higher, except naphtha.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly higher on Friday except for naphtha.
Gasoline prices rose, helped by low refinery production and buying in the paper market ahead of the U.K. government's November 26 budget, traders said.
Northwest Europe naphtha prices eased slightly after Algeria's Skikda port reopened for loadings after closing on Tuesday morning due to bad weather.
Gas oil firmed on stronger IPE futures, but increased supply put pressure on low sulphur diesel premiums and heating oil, traders said.
High sulphur fuel barges corrected from Thursday's dip, trading $2 up at $124-125 fob ARA. Cargo prices were flat.
